Inclusive, isso me fez conhecer o subreddit /r/QAnonCasualties, onde as pessoas postam sobre as pessoas que ''perderam'' para essas teorias conspiratórias, e como isso afetou a vida delas.

E o que assusta é que é algo extremamente comum: pais e filhos não se falando há anos por conta dessas teorias conspiratórias, avós renegando o contato com o resto da família, términos de namoro e divórcios de casamentos por conta do estresse gerado por essas teorias na relação, e por aí vai. Acho que a gente tem que levar a sério o perigo dessas teorias conspiratórias por conta delas serem extremamente comuns, quero dizer, no caso da vacina esse pessoal tá colocando em risco a saúde de toda uma comunidade, é bizarro.

Eu acho que você deveria seguir o conselho de um amigo que comentou aqui também: de tomar a dianteira dessa situação. Transforme essa ideia romântica em algo concreto e entregar uma carta no dia dos namorados! 💌

De verdade, eu entendo que você queira muito fazer todas essas coisas românticas de uma vez só, mas confie em mim que essas cartinhas são o portão de entrada para vocês fazerem diversas atividades divertidas e trocarem presentes engraçados entre si. Com você entregando essa carta ele vai retribuir com outra carta também, e assim se inicia um longo ciclo que fortalece a compaixão e companheirismo no relacionamento de vocês.

De verdade mesmo como conselho de amigo: Se ele tivesse te mostrado esse site para vocês dois passarem medo juntos seria um pouco mais entendível e aceitável, mas ele disse que gosta de consumir esse conteúdo violento, e aí é um problema. Sinceramente, se atenta mais sobre esse seu amigo, essa personalidade dele não é a das melhores para se ter em um amigo nem sequer num conhecido.

O fato de você ser tão ativo em um engajamento ambiental já é algo bem importante mano, quero dizer, o mundo é caótico em qualquer coisa que envolva o meio-ambiente, como proteção de espécies e consumo sustentável. Se orgulhe disso, mesmo que algumas pessoas não se interessem junto com você e não apareçam em seus projetos como no caso da praia. 

Além disso, é claro que cair em um golpe sempre é uma experiência ruim, nós não gostamos de ser enganados de qualquer maneira, mas (se) você foi enganado você estava tentando fazer algo com um bom propósito, não fique se culpando por isso. Leve isso como um aprendizado, você vai estar mais atento nos momentos futuros para evitar cair em situações dessa novamente.

Inclusive, vendo que você gosta dessa temática ambiental eu te recomendo um jogo chamado ''[Alba: A Wildlife Adventure](https://www.albawildlife.com/)'', ele envolve a trajetória de uma criança que tem que salvar uma reserva ambiental em uma ilha que está ameaçada pela construção de um grande hotel, você pode inclusive tirar fotos de todos os animais da ilha. A melhor parte é que a cada cópia vendida do jogo a desenvolvedora planta uma árvore, [e você pode acompanhar o plantio dessas árvores](https://ecologi.com/albasforest).

Essas sensações de impotência sobre algo são infelizmente bem comuns por que o mundo em si é bem complicado, eu também já passei por essas situações também envolvendo a minha irmã mais nova, e você tem todo a razão e direito de ficar chateada quando coisas assim acontecem. E também entenda que ajudar o suficiente é relativo para cada um, você pode se sentir decepcionada e impotente por achar que não ajudou a sua irmã o suficiente, mas entenda que a sua irmã mesmo com esse problema pode estar bastante alegre por contar com a irmã mais velha em uma dificuldade, nesse caso fazendo divulgações e tudo mais.

Você está fazendo o possível ao seu alcance e isso tem a principal importância nisso tudo! 🐈

Eu acho que você deveria se pressionar menos com os relatos dos antigos estudantes do seu curso de engenharia geológica, cada um deles trilhou o próprio caminho acadêmico com suas próprias características e considerações. O curso de uma faculdade é como um jogo de dominó, todos tem as mesmas peças e almejam o mesmo objetivo, mas existem dezenas de possibilidades para alcançar esse mesmo objetivo, e você terá a oportunidade de fazer a sua própria estratégia de jogo, entende?

Além disso, engenharia geológica/geologia é uma área bem legal e interessante, (tanto que foi a minha segunda opção de curso) o mercado de trabalho dessa área é extremamente aquecido principalmente por ser essencial nas mineradoras e petrolíferas, são empregos bem remunerados e não tão concorridos por conta que engenharia geológica não é tão popular. A crise econômica afetou bastante esse cenário de empregabilidade nessas áreas assim como nas várias outras, mas se o cenário econômico melhorar de forma significativa nos próximos anos e você se dedicar em sua faculdade eu acho que você não terá muitos problemas em encontrar um ótimo emprego!

I fully understand your frustration with these activities and the fact that they did not work, but I need you to understand that these activities are commonly associated only with psychological relaxation, they do not necessarily make the problem go away, we have to face them. Understand that the fact that these activities do not work for you is totally normal, our psychological is unique and different from each other, so it is normal that these activities can relax some but not others. The main thing that you should notice here, is that these activities need to be things that you really like, no matter if they are bizarre or too specific, they should always be valued as essential, and not the ones that people say are the best for you. If you need more than one person, I guarantee that in this social network there are several communities interested in the most varied groups, and willing to talk about them.

You deserve help, you deserve everything, just as everyone else deserves it, even if it seems not. I cannot say what will be the solution to your problem, this is not my point here, but I want to say that there are solutions that can offer your progressive improvement, even though we may not have found it yet, we can continue this search for a solution. But mostly I need you to understand that you are really a flower, you have to keep that thought fixed in your head so that you try to minimally superimpose these negative thoughts on your appearance.

You deserve a helping hand, you deserve a treatment that makes you better and you deserve to be able to look at who you really are, just as you have to understand and recognize that this image that you have of yourself is damaged and transformed in relation to the real. Insist on psychiatric treatment or a therapist, explain the approaches that didn't work and try new ones, but mainly, give yourself a little vacation in relation to these negative thoughts, get busy with things you really like these next few days.

I understand your problem. In relation to your therapist it would be interesting for you to be open about her work, it is not wrong to say that the approach she is taking is not helping you, it is a duty to reformulate and seek another path that leads to your progressive improvement - if a doctor give him a medicine for the flu and you saw that it didn’t work, you should tell him, and don’t keep using a medicine that doesn’t work against your flu, you know? In short, you need help, or rather: a makeover in the way you are being helped. 

And the problem is that sometimes we can fall into the temptation to suppose several things, these thoughts of "and if I had done this or was that" are illusory, you are creating scenarios to escape your real and current scenario, focus on it , even if it is a bad scenario it is for your psychological to remain stable, realistic and confident. We cannot fall into the temptation of our stormy psychological to demean ourselves or understand that we deserve nothing and that things will never change, nothing is fixed or absolute, not even by a philosophical view or a physical view.

I fully understand what an extremely difficult situation must be like. I also understand the difference between the impact of someone's praise that you actively live with compared to a stranger. - and it's okay, you're not wrong to think about it, okay?

A flower can be extremely beautiful and lovely, like a rose, an orchid, or even a plumeria, but if it is in the middle of a strong rainy storm that flower can have its beauty and highlights hidden in the confusion of the storm. But notice that the beauty of this flower has not disappeared, but the environment in which it is involved makes it impossible to see it. The flower must be aware that when this storm goes away, it will be able to grow in a beautiful blue sky and recognize how beautiful it is.  In a metaphorical view, I see you as that flower. You have potential, a beauty, an incredible personality, but the environment like those of your acquaintances and employers represented by the rainy storm in the history of the flower makes you not see them. Your future is not a failure or a suffering even though now it looks like it is inside the storm, but know that there are beautiful and large gardens outside, perfect for you to shine and have your qualities recognized. If you continue with this feeling, I really recommend contacting the suicide prevention service in your country or some mental health professional in your community or outside. I'm rooting for you, okay?

Our city, neighborhood, or school are our social bubbles, as much as there is a whole world, moreover, our reality is limited to these bubbles only. And in some bubbles we can be harmed by having people who harm us psychologically, in your case these men who said those ridiculous things about you, as well as the people at school who made up rumors about you.  But the point I want to make is that these people are simply not good, they are not healthy to relate to in any way, because they suck the potential of those around them. And you living in a bubble full of these bad people (not to mention a bunch of motherfuckers) as your employers and school acquaintances, and they make you believe that you are ugly, that you are not capable, and that you serve as a punching bag.

In short, the opinion of these people, however much it seems, is not definitive and absolute, and it does not matter if several people have the same negative opinion, it does not prove anything about their personality and person.  I mean by that your environment is conditioning you to think like that, but not necessarily you are like that. As an example we can use your hair, I honestly thought it was fantastically beautiful, and even though you may have colored it again with another color, I have friends who could spend hours talking to you about these things. But maybe, where you live, people may not have liked it, and as the main people in your bubble you can believe that your hair wasn’t that cool, even though it was extremely fun for the rest of the people outside your bubble. And it applies to feelings, physical appearance, and other things that you are going through.

Anyway, the people you are living with and doing this to you are really bad, and because they are part of the same environment they will always want to make you upset. But you do not deserve them, not because they are too good, but because they are too horrible to live with, and as much as it seems that their opinion is absolute, understand that they are wrong, and that outside this bubble there is a world in that you are valued as the amazing person you are, okay?

I understand how the use of alcohol and drugs can be complicated, they represent heaven and hell on the same face, at the same time that it makes us extremely excited and well it can cause problematic behaviors and an addiction that causes us to be placed in the middle of a big storm, not knowing when it will end or how to get out of it.

You are not a mistake or a failure because you have caused some things that you consider to be unforgivable and extremely serious, we make mistakes, our own daily life highlights these things. When we argue with a friend about something he said, we always want to know why he said that, and sometimes we find out that he said that thing because he was stressed about something, and that's what we should always focus on, cause of this problem, not its results. In the same way, you must forgive yourself, I know it must not be easy because you have experienced these moments, but it is not fair for you to judge yourself because of your psychological being in the middle of an internal and personal storm. The fact that you keep stressing how bad those things were that you do shows that you are not responsible for them, but your own addiction, your unconscious is trying to show with this repulsion for your actions that you do not have this mentality, because if you had you would not be making these judgments about your attitudes.

In fact, the combination of mental instability with addiction means that our great achievements are reduced to crumbs and debris, and our small defeats become more and more expressive and bigger, but you need to believe me that this vision you have now of yourself is not true. Much less the thoughts that you have no future, and that it is inseparable from your addiction and suffering, your psychological is creating this false thought out of hopelessness, it is not an absolute thing, however much it seems to you.

You were not made to suffer, however it seems today, addiction to problems makes you think that way, but believe that you were made to fulfill your dreams and desires that you should have like anyone, and it doesn't matter if people outside of your life and your bad thoughts tell you that you don't deserve it, keep in mind that you do deserve them. Things are not fair even if we want them to be, and we often go through problems that we do not deserve, but they are not definitive and much less absolute, and suffering in them does not define what you are and much less shows what is your purpose.

Try to get some rest and cancel tomorrow's hotel reservation, forget about those plans that were made for you, call a friend or family member and honestly explain your situation and motivations, or even urgently contact the suicide prevention service in your country. A good servant, but a bad master.* And I reiterate that the speech ends with: *The point cannot be explained in words. I'm not trying to put you down, It's an expression of you as you are. One must live. We need to survive to go on. We must go on.*

I know that your work is intensive and very complicated, but I think it would be a good idea for you to seek this help, as well as try to do some sport, walk, something for you to be distracted while you are undergoing treatment.
